citation.authors: Mah E, Garcia-Campayo V, Liska D
citation.title: Substitution of Corn Starch with Resistant Starch Type 4 in a Breakfast Bar Decreases Postprandial Glucose and Insulin Responses: A Randomized, Controlled, Crossover Study

population.description: 21 healthy adults (11 women, 10 men), Table 2 (n = 21, means ± SDs). Age 20-45 y was an enrolment criterion, so min and max are null; BMI range 19.3-27.0 kg/m2 is the observed range printed in Results and Abstract. Fasting glucose <=110 mg/dL, no diabetes, hypertension or cardiovascular disease by history and chemistry profile. Table 2 title says n = 21 while its footnote says it holds the per-protocol sample, which Table 3 gives as n = 20; n = 21 is kept because Table 2's percentages (11/21 = 52.4%, 15/21 = 71.4%, 5/21 = 23.8%) only fit 21.

protocols.name: fasted_screening
protocols.description: Participants' baseline blood pressure (Table 2: systolic and diastolic), modelled as a short fasted morning arm with water only. Table 2 does not say when, in what posture or on which visit the pressures were taken (Methods do not mention blood pressure measurement); the test visits were attended fasted 12-14 h (a range, not a value), entered as the guide's overnight 10 h.
